name: slop-review
description: Root manifest for pi (`pi install git:github.com/danmactough/slop-review`). Points pi at the extension that lives under ./plugin/. Claude Code and Codex CLI ignore this file and read ./plugin/package.json instead.

scripts.preversion: echo "You must use 'npm version prerelease --preid fork' to bump the version. Continue? (y/n)" && read answer && [[ $answer == [Yy]* ]] || exit 1
scripts.version: npm run version:manifests $npm_new_version && npm version --prefix plugin $npm_new_version && git add -A .agents/plugins/marketplace.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugin/package.json plugin/package-lock.json package-lock.json
